units: <cite ref="Pesachim 15b">Pes. 15ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 45b:17">45ᵇ</cite> <he>הפת שעִיפְּשָׁה וכ׳</he> bread that is spoiled so as to be unfit for man to eat &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 2:4">Tosef. ib. II</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 3:4">III</cite>), 4 <he>שעִיפְּשׁוּ או שיבשו</he> which have become mouldy or dried up.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 9:10">Tosef. Ter. IX, 10</cite> <he>פת שעִיפֵּישָׁה</he> (ed. Zuck.). Tanḥ. Mick. 7 <he>פת … עִפְּשָׁה</he> the bread in our vessels has become mouldy.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:9:2">Y. Yoma III, 41ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>לא היתה מְעַפֶּשֶׁת</he> it never grew mouldy; Bab.

<cite ref="Yoma 38a:7">ib. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>מִתְעַפֶּשֶׁת</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:5">Tosef. ib. II, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:19">Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מתע׳</he>; a. e.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>שלא ירקבו ולא יִתְעַפְּשׁוּ וכ׳</he> that they (the fruits in the ark) should not rot, or mould, or be disfigured.
